dialog.title: Reset takes 20 seconds
dialog.subtitle: This screen will not close during the reset process
dialog.point1: Reset is complete when the second LED stops fast blinking, then turns solid.
dialog.point2: Connect your mobile device to the new WiFi network called
dialog.point3: Add Winderoo to an existing WiFi network. If the LED starts to slow blink, Winderoo has successfully joined that network.
dialog.point4: Wait for your device to reconnect to your existing WiFi network.

settings.internalClockBlurb: Winderoo has an internal clock (RTC), which is automatically set during boot.
settings.internalClockBlurb2: If this is incorrect, please update the clock beneath.
